text:
carla_sec: Alert: WAF anomaly rule firing for sustained spike against /api/generate — ~2.5k r/s, elevated 5xxs. Looks like layer7 abuse, multiple source ASNs.

ben_sre: Seeing the same in infra graphs, LB CPU trending up and queue latency increasing. Origin mostly international but top ASNs show up (395747, 20473).

alice_ops: I’ll start mitigation: temporary per-IP rate limit on /api/generate to 20r/s, block the top offending ASNs, and push stricter WAF signatures. Assigning to me to run changes.

dave_api: Heads up — per-IP limits will hit bulk integrations. Which customers should we whitelist?

support_liaison: Quick check: customer_acme and customer_spark are heavy on that endpoint. They use API keys ak_acme_123 and ak_spark_zzz. Recommend whitelisting those keys in the limiter.

carla_sec: Implementing block for top 100 offending IPs and ASNs 395747,20473. Adding a challenge (403) rule for suspicious UA patterns. Also enabling request header logging for matching requests.

ben_sre: Pushing WAF rule via API now:
```sh
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/waf/rules \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"action\":\"block\",\"match\":\"asn:395747\"}'
```

incident-bot: autoscaler: added 6 inference workers in us-west-2 to handle increased load (event id: asg-evt-8791).

alice_ops: Rolling rate-limit config: per-IP 20r/s on /api/generate, exception list for api keys [ak_acme_123, ak_spark_zzz]. Non-whitelisted clients will receive 429 + Retry-After. Deploying now.

dave_api: Can we confirm we captured full request headers + bodies (scrub PII) for blocked requests into a secure bucket for triage?

carla_sec: Yes — logs shipped to s3://redwood-incident-logs/1759990012/ with server-side encryption. KMS key: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01-2345. Access restricted to sec + sre roles. Filing ticket INV-321 to add retention and access review.

support_liaison: Drafting status page message: \"We are mitigating abnormal traffic affecting some API requests. Verified customers are not impacted; unverified clients may see reduced throughput. Monitoring ongoing.\" Ping if wording needs changes.

ben_sre: Good news — traffic dropped to ~300r/s after blocks, LB latency normalized, error rate back to baseline. WAF blocks account for >95% of matches. Recommend keeping mitigations for 24h, then staged rollback.

carla_sec: Agreed. Action items: (1) maintain per-IP limit 20r/s for 24h, (2) keep ASN blocks for 24h, (3) whitelist verified API keys, (4) create postmortem and follow-ups: refine detection thresholds, automate ASN blacklisting, add per-customer telemetry and alerting. Owner: carla_sec. Due: EOD tomorrow.

alice_ops: Creating postmortem doc INV-321 in #postmortems, adding follow-up tickets and owners. Will circulate draft after initial triage. :white_check_mark:

carla_sec: After-action notes: need to add a playbook step to automatically notify account execs for affected verified customers, and add a toggle in the rate-limiter to whitelist by API product tier. Adding to INV-321.

support_liaison: I'll notify the account reps for customer_acme and customer_spark and attach mitigation timeline.

ben_sre: Closing loop — monitoring for next 6h, if stable we start rollback test at +24h with gradual removal of ASN blocks and lift per-IP to 100r/s then back to default.

carla_sec: Thanks all. Saving logs, labels, and timeline to the postmortem. Will schedule a 30m retro tomorrow.
